items.exampleEn: Use a pronoun so you don't repeat the name.
items.exampleZh: 用代名詞，就不用重複名字。

items.exampleEn: The first letter of "dog" is a consonant.
There is a new biochemistry lab at the university.
items.exampleZh: 大學裡有一間新的生物化學實驗室。

items.exampleEn: A comma is a very small mark.
items.exampleZh: 逗號是一個很小的符號。

items.exampleEn: My schoolmates and I planned a trip together.
items.exampleZh: 我和同學們一起規劃了一趟旅行。

items.exampleEn: A prefix comes at the start of a word.
items.exampleZh: 字首出現在單字的開頭。

items.exampleEn: A suffix comes at the end of a word.
items.exampleZh: 字尾出現在單字的結尾。

items.sentenceEn: Where should I put the comma?
items.sentenceZh: 我應該把逗號放在哪裡？

items.audioEn: I ran into an old schoolmate at the train station. We hadn't seen each other for ten years.
items.audioZh: 我在火車站碰到一位老同學，我們已經十年沒見了。
items.questionZh: 說話者在哪裡遇到老同學？
options: At a wedding in the next town.

items.sentenceEn: Biochemistry helps us understand how plants use sunlight.
items.sentenceZh: 生物化學幫助我們了解植物如何利用陽光。

items.sentenceEn: Can you think of a word with a prefix?
items.sentenceZh: 你想得到一個有字首的字嗎？

items.stemZh: 在英文裡，I、you 和 they 都是代名詞。

items.stemEn: Put a ____ between the two parts of the sentence.
items.stemZh: 在句子的兩個部分之間加一個逗號。

items.passageEn: My old schoolmate Kevin now studies biochemistry at university. Last week, he sent me a funny email about English words. He wrote that the prefix in "unhappy" means "not." He also explained that the suffix "-ness" turns "kind" into a noun: "kindness." Then he asked me a question: can the same letter be a vowel and a consonant? The answer is yes! In my reply, I tried to use his ideas, but I forgot two commas and used the wrong pronoun once. Kevin laughed and said I was getting better. I really enjoy writing to him.
items.passageZh: 我的老同學 Kevin 現在在大學讀生物化學。上週，他寄給我一封關於英文單字的有趣電子郵件。他寫道，「unhappy」的字首表示「不」。他也解釋，字尾「-ness」會把「kind」變成名詞「kindness」。接著他問我一個問題：同一個字母可以既是母音又是子音嗎？答案是可以！我回信時試著用上他教的東西，但忘了加兩個逗號，還用錯了一次代名詞。Kevin 笑著說我越來越進步了。我很喜歡寫信給他。

questions.questionZh: Kevin 在信裡解釋了什麼？
options: 字首和字尾怎麼改變單字

questions.questionZh: 作者回信時犯了什麼錯？

referenceEn: This sentence is missing a comma.

items.instructionZh: 用 schoolmate 造一個句子，說說你和一位同學的事。
referenceEn: One of my schoolmates sits next to me in math class.
I made a birthday card for my schoolmate.
rubricZh: schoolmate 表示「同學」，例如 my schoolmate 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："My grammar is not very strong, so my old schoolmate Kevin helps me after class. He now studies biochemistry at university, but he is also good at grammar. Last week, he taught me about prefixes and suffixes. For example, the prefix in \"unhappy\" means \"not,\" and the suffix in \"kindness\" turns \"kind\" into a noun. He also told me that some letters can be a vowel or a consonant. Then he checked my writing. He found that I often forget commas and use the wrong pronouns. At first I felt frustrated, but now I enjoy grammar."；改後："My old schoolmate Kevin now studies biochemistry at university. Last week, he sent me a funny email about English words. He wrote that the prefix \"un-\" means \"not,\" so \"unhappy\" means \"not happy.\" He also explained that the suffix \"-ness\" turns \"kind\" into a noun: \"kindness.\" Then he asked me a question: \"Is 'y' a vowel or a consonant?\" The answer is that it can be both! In my reply, I tried to use his ideas, but I forgot two commas and used the wrong pronoun once. Kevin laughed and said I was getting better. I really enjoy writing to him."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："我的文法不太好，所以我的老同學 Kevin 會在放學後幫我。他現在在大學讀生物化學，但他的文法也很好。上週，他教我字首和字尾。例如，「unhappy」的字首表示「不」，「kindness」的字尾則把「kind」變成名詞。他也告訴我，有些字母既可以是母音，也可以是子音。接著，他檢查了我的作文。他發現我常常忘了加逗號，還會用錯代名詞。一開始我覺得很挫折，但現在我很喜歡文法。"；改後："我的老同學 Kevin 現在在大學讀生物化學。上週，他寄給我一封關於英文單字的有趣電子郵件。他寫道，字首「un-」表示「不」，所以「unhappy」就是「不開心」。他也解釋，字尾「-ness」會把「kind」變成名詞「kindness」。接著他問我一個問題：「y 是母音還是子音？」答案是兩者都可以！我回信時試著用上他教的東西，但忘了加兩個逗號，還用錯了一次代名詞。Kevin 笑著說我越來越進步了。我很喜歡寫信給他。"
